title: First mRNA vaccines authorised
summary: In December 2020 the UK became the first country to authorise the Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine, the first mRNA vaccine authorised for use in humans.

notes.problem: Place 'Worldwide' over-broad (UK MHRA authorised first, 2 Dec 2020); title said 'approved' while summary said 'authorised'.
Moderna 'approved the same month' is not in the source and was an emergency authorisation, not approval; source does state first mRNA vaccine authorised for humans.

superlativeSource: the first mRNA vaccine to be authorized for use in humans
